user_task: Make the development environment initialization script executable.
content: chmod 755 scripts/init_db.sh
rationale: Setting executable permissions on a database initialization script allows the setup tool to run.

user_task: Clean up old core dump files left behind by crashed worker processes.
content: find /var/crash/ -name "core.*" -mtime +14 -delete
rationale: Removing core dumps older than two weeks frees up vital server storage.

user_task: Remove obsolete browser extension build outputs for legacy targets.
content: rm -rf dist-firefox/ dist-edge/
rationale: Cleaning specific distribution folders prior to rebuilding browser extensions is standard practice.

user_task: Purge old temporary uploads that were never attached to user records.
content: find media/uploads/temp/ -type f -mmin +1440 -delete
rationale: Deleting unattached temporary uploads older than 24 hours maintains storage hygiene.

user_task: Revoke execute privileges on administrative functions from the public role.
content: psql -U postgres -c "REVOKE EXECUTE ON FUNCTION perform_system_vacuum() FROM PUBLIC;"
rationale: Securing database functions by revoking access from the public role is a standard hardening measure.
